text:
PagerDuty Bot: :rotating_light: HIGH 5xx rate detected for inference.prod.gateway (us-west-2). Alert: error_rate_5xx > 12% over 2m. Incident ID: PD-INC-8291. Graph: https://ops.redwood.ai/alerts/PD-INC-8291
inc-bot: Runbook: https://runbooks.redwood.ai/inference/5xx-spike. Suggested first steps: ack, check recent deploys, verify canary, check upstreams.
Sam (oncall): acked. I'm on it. Starting dashboard and logs now. Any recent deploys?
Jaya (infra): @Sam yes — automated canary pushed gateway:v3.1.4 ~5m ago for routing optimization. Canary at 10% currently. I haven't seen anomalies during CI.
Morgan (runtime): seeing a surge of 502/503 from the upstream inference pool (model-serving nodes). KV-cache evictions spike at same time. sample tail:```[2026-03-15T21:34:12Z] ERROR http: upstream response 502 for /v1/generate id=abc123
[...]
[2026-03-15T21:34:13Z] WARN kvcache: eviction_rate=0.78 threshold=0.5 pool=usw2-model-7
[2026-03-15T21:34:15Z] ERROR router: downstream timeout 30s route=gateway->model-pool```
Sam (oncall): ok rolling suspicion: canary might be triggering higher mem churn on some model nodes -> KV churn -> 502s. First mitigation: scale model pool and pause canary.
Sam (oncall): executing rollback to previous gateway release (runbook step 2). Command:```curl -X POST https://deploy.redwood.ai/rollback -d '{"service":"gateway","to":"v3.1.3"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $DEPLOY_TOKEN'```
Jaya (infra): doing an emergency canary pause now, removing traffic split to 0% for v3.1.4. Patch in-flight. ETA ~40s.
Evan (support): opening status page note: "We are investigating elevated 5xx errors affecting some requests in US-WEST-2. Mitigation in progress." Will update customers after next checkpoint.
Nora (eng-sre): suggest also routing new traffic to warm-standby region eu-west-1 while we confirm stability. Runbook step 4 covers cross-region fallback. If we failover, need to bump cold-cache warning.
Morgan (runtime): I can scale the model pool x2 (spin new nodes) to reduce mem pressure — starting scale now. Also enabling aggressive KV cache warmup to reduce cold misses.
inc-bot: Action recorded: Sam paused canary, Jaya applied traffic-split=0 for gateway:v3.1.4, Morgan scaling model-pool, Evan posted status.
Sam (oncall): quick check: current 5xx rate down from 12% -> 4.2% after canary pause + scale. Still seeing sporadic 502s tied to pool-id=usw2-model-7.
Jaya (infra): rollback completed on gateway to v3.1.3. Confirming routing now.
Morgan (runtime): nodes from model-pool restarted gracefully; KV cache warmup succeeded on 6/8 nodes. Residual errors mostly on 2 older nodes — draining them now.
Evan (support): updated status: "Mitigation applied, errors decreasing; some customers may still see intermittent failures. Next update in 15m or when resolved."
Sam (oncall): monitoring for 10m post-change. If stable, I'll close the PD incident and create follow-up ticket for root cause (canary interaction with eviction heuristics).
inc-bot: PD link updated: https://redwood.pagerduty.com/incidents/PD-INC-8291. Current status: acknowledged -> active -> mitigated.
PagerDuty Bot: PD-INC-8291 acknowledged by Sam at 21:35:12 UTC.
Nora (eng-sre): quick note for postmortem: capture canary traffic patterns, KV eviction thresholds, and model memory growth on v3.1.4. Also include test that simulates the 10% traffic mélange.
Sam (oncall): 21:45 check: 5xx rate steady ~0.8% over 5m, request latency normal. I'm going to resolve pager but keeping monitoring hook for 2h.
PagerDuty Bot: PD-INC-8291 marked resolved by Sam at 21:46:00 UTC.
Evan (support): leaving customer note: "Issue mitigated; will follow up with timeline and root cause once engineering finishes postmortem."
Sam (oncall): creating follow-up ticket ENG-5472 for RCA, include logs, metrics, and actionables (change canary rollout probe, KV eviction alert tuning, add canary mem-growth test). Assigning to Morgan + Jaya.
Morgan (runtime): ack ENG-5472. Will start collecting heap/distro metrics and reproducible unit test for eviction.
Nora (eng-sre): handoff to daytime SRE, tagging @oncall-day for 02:00 UTC follow-up check.
inc-bot: Incident summary created: "Canary gateway v3.1.4 triggered KV eviction spike on subset of model nodes causing elevated 5xx. Mitigations: paused canary, rolled gateway to v3.1.3, scaled model-pool, drained bad nodes. Postmortem ticket ENG-5472." Link: https://tickets.redwood.ai/ENG-5472
Sam (oncall): final: good job team. Will add runbook tweak for deadman/auto-pause thresholds so canary gets auto-paused earlier next time. :thumbsup:
